Rank graph nodes based on configurable c: Rank graph nodes based on configurable criteria such as 'number of inbound edges'. These rankings can be used in the graph find/hide feature to help highlight the most important workloads, services, and applications. Rankings are normalized to fit between 1..100 and nodes may tie with each other in rank. Ranking starts at 1 for the top ranked nodes so when ranking nodes based on 'number of inbound edges', the node(s) with the most inbound edges would have rank 1. Node(s) with the second most inbound edges would have rank 2. Each selected criteria contributes equally to a node's ranking. Although 100 rankings are possible, only the required number of rankings are assigned, starting at 1.
